contract: DESIGN.md: retain original Career Valley logo; warm ivory, sage and peach light surfaces; readable forest primary actions; shared tokens; no horizontal overflow at mobile and desktop; preserve existing routes and footer video.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard Tab reveals the skip link with a 3px forest focus outline. Desktop and mobile menus close with Escape; mobile focus returns to the trigger. Consultation opens with a labelled close button and closes with Escape. Selected explorer controls expose aria-pressed. Calculated contrast: primary action 6.88:1, muted on ivory 5.13:1, muted on sage 4.66:1, muted on peach 4.55:1. Reduced motion uses static pathway cards. This is targeted verification, not a full accessibility audit.

responsive.evidence: Nine routes checked at both 390x844 and 1440x900 (18 completed measurements in results.json): home, about, services, contact, events, undergraduate colleges, college explorer, B.Tech guide, and login. No horizontal document overflow or console/page errors. Inspected representative mobile and desktop screenshots, normal-motion pathway cards, and explorer selection. Intentional scrolling card rails remain contained.

loading.evidence: Browser-local delayed event API fixture shows Loading events skeletons with light token surfaces; application loading spinner also observed.

empty.evidence: Browser-local empty events response shows the existing No upcoming events right now message and recovery guidance.

error.evidence: Browser-local failed events response shows the existing error UI and Try again action; recorded in interactions.json.

partial.evidence: Home preview events remain visible with the preview-schedule notice while the schedule is unavailable. Some remote photos were unavailable or slow in captures; their layout remains reserved.

success.evidence: Selecting Business in the explorer updates its pressed state and renders BBA, B.Com and MBA course links. Consultation open/close succeeds. These are client-side interaction checks; no server-side registration or authentication success is claimed.

permission.reason: The palette and logo change introduces no permission request or protected action. Existing authenticated registration is outside this visual validation and was not submitted.

renderedEvidence.observation: Original unfiltered logo, light hero, readable primary and secondary actions, and responsive mobile layout.
Light contact cards, labelled form fields and primary action; footer retains original branding.
Full desktop navigation fits alongside the original logo; warm light overlay keeps the image and forest heading readable.
Sage and peach shared hero treatment, light story visual and strong green action.
Normal-motion pathway section is light with readable forest text and white detail cards.
Business selection uses a high-contrast primary state; related course links and secondary copy are readable on light surfaces.
Original logo, white login surface, readable labels and forest action without document overflow.
Light sage-to-peach course hero and contained horizontal course navigation. Existing typewriter text captured mid-animation.
Locally mocked event error and retry action; corrected light footer with original logo and readable labels, background rgb(237, 242, 235), ink rgb(32, 59, 51).

limitations: External photo and university-logo loading varies by provider; some captures contain reserved media areas.
Live authentication, registration and email delivery were not submitted. Event state validation uses local browser fixtures.
